exceptions.rationale: Lockfile-only entry via rust_decimal/sqlx-mysql. cargo tree -i rkyv prints nothing for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-apple-darwin, or --target all --all-features; linkgo enables only sqlx sqlite + runtime-tokio. Fix needs rkyv 0.8.17, which requires an upstream sqlx/rust_decimal change.

Lockfile-only entry via sqlx-mysql (optional MySQL backend, not enabled). cargo tree -i rsa prints nothing for all three desktop targets or --all-features; linkgo performs no RSA operations. No patched rsa release exists.

Linux-only transitive dependency of tauri/wry/tray-icon through gtk 0.18. Unsoundness is in glib::VariantStrIter, which linkgo never calls. Fix needs glib 0.20, which requires a Tauri gtk-rs major upgrade upstream.
Proc-macro helper used only at compile time via the gtk3-macros/glib-macros chain on Linux. Unmaintained, no known vulnerability, no maintained replacement available without an upstream change.
